name: rectangular centered crop
test:
image = [list(range(r * 6, (r + 1) * 6)) for r in range(4)]
assert center_crop(image, 2, 4) == [[7, 8, 9, 10], [13, 14, 15, 16]]

name: full image copy
test:
image = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]
out = center_crop(image, 2, 3)
assert out == image and out is not image
assert all(a is not b for a, b in zip(out, image))

name: one pixel
test:
image = [list(range(r * 5, (r + 1) * 5)) for r in range(5)]
assert center_crop(image, 1, 1) == [[12]]

name: input independence
test:
image = [[1,2,3],[4,5,6],[7,8,9]]
before = [row[:] for row in image]
out = center_crop(image, 1, 1)
out[0][0] = -99
assert image == before
